screens: D-pad moves between categories and player controls. Confirm opens or activates. SQUARE opens Now Playing.
Up/Down selects. Confirm opens a group or plays a track. Back returns. TRIANGLE opens a contextual action where available.
D-pad moves focus. Confirm activates. LYRICS appears when available; SPEED is always available. TRIANGLE opens Spectrum. SQUARE opens Cassette.
Left/Right changes palette. Tap L/R to change track. Back or TRIANGLE returns to Now Playing. SQUARE opens Cassette.
Left/Right selects a band or PREAMP. Up/Down changes gain. SQUARE toggles EQ. TRIANGLE cycles presets. Back returns.
Left/Right changes Lyrics color. Confirm plays or pauses. Back returns to Now Playing.
Open Track Information from Information. Left/Right or L/R changes page. Up/Down scrolls. Back returns.
Left/Right changes color. START or Confirm plays or pauses. Back or SQUARE returns to Now Playing.
Confirm/Back follow the PSP system Cross/Circle assignment automatically. SELECT opens About. HOME opens the PSP exit dialog.
systemButtonAssignment: Confirm and Back follow the PSP system Cross/Circle assignment automatically.
